timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1530 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has weakened significantly to 1530 KRW per USD—the highest level since March 31, 2026, and the first time breaking through 1530 since the global financial crisis. This means you need MORE won to buy the same $2,000, driven by geopolitical tensions (US-Iran conflict), foreign investor selloffs, and capital outflows from Korea.

TIP: Consider setting a monthly limit-buy order at a stronger won level (lower KRW/USD rate), or split your $2,000 purchase across multiple dates to average out the weak-won period rather than converting all at once at this unfavorable rate.
